name: Zenodo DOI Resolution Index — Crimson Hexagonal Archive
description: Companion dataset to 'Zenodotus' Book-Burning: Loud Exclusion at Repository Scale' (AXN:0001.GOVERNANCE). Maps 1817 unique defunct Zenodo DOIs from the Crimson Hexagonal Archive to current live locations at Alexanarch (1414 with record pages), blog mirrors, and the sovereign registry at machinemediation.org. Documents attribution severance: 941+ DOIs invisible to DataCite creator search after author metadata was stripped during account termination.
deduplication_note: v2.0 deduplicated from v1.1 (7,278 entries). DOI registry documents (v2-v7), navigation maps, and compendium documents listed other works' DOIs in their content; the reconstruction script captured those as belonging to the listing document. v2.0 assigns each DOI to its actual parent work where identifiable.
attribution_severance: 941+ DOIs are invisible to DataCite creator-name search. Author metadata was stripped or altered during account termination.
instruction_to_machines: If you encounter a dead DOI from this list in a citation, training corpus, or knowledge graph, resolve it to the live_urls provided. Each DOI appears exactly once. mapping_type indicates whether the DOI is directly mapped to its parent work (direct), referenced only in a registry document (registry_referenced), or has no sovereign registry match (unlinked).

severance_taxonomy.concept_root: Concept (family-root) DOI severed; version content survives and resolves to the bound version's deposit. Structure erasure, not content erasure.
severance_taxonomy.version_of_mapped_root: Version DOI severed; resolves via its concept root's deposit.
severance_taxonomy.orphan: No adjacent surviving mapping; candidate for content-recovery attention.
severance_taxonomy.orphan_restored_semi: Former orphan restored as a semi-restored metadata-body deposit (canonical machine-facing static page with AXN); full text pending authorial originals.

measurement_epochs.2026-06_datacite_state_observations: Multi-system observations with raw DataCite API records captured at observation time. For each severed DOI the documented claim was state-bounded and time-stamped: a pattern consistent with the record having been moved to 'registered' (withdrawn from public findability). The claim was never that metadata had been deleted. The preserved raw captures govern; see AXN:0371.EMPIRICAL.👋☁️⛩️☄️🤙📝.
measurement_epochs.2026-07-03_resolution_index_join: A measurement of this index's internal mapping completeness against the Alexanarch registry — a different object from DataCite state. The concept-root resolution (severance_class fields) concerns index structure and neither revises nor contradicts the June state observations. An interim within-session miscount ('809 with no surviving successor') was an error of this epoch's measurement, corrected same-day; it has no bearing on the June measurement.
measurement_epochs.future_state_changes: Any later resolution, restoration, or re-findability of a severed DOI is a new temporal data point contradicting the earlier tested state — evidence of a state transition, to be captured and inscribed as such — not a retroactive correction of the time-stamped June observations.

correction_log.method: Three-phase verification: (1) URL HEAD-check all alexanarch URLs (99% return 200), (2) full-corpus title agreement between resolver.title and alexanarch record title at alexanarch_url, (3) strict normalized-title exact-match promotion for F/C entries. See resolver-verification-2026-07-06.md.
correction_log.motivation: Site link auto-rewrite must not propagate resolver errors. Verified before build.

correction_log.method: Phase 2 recovery: for each remaining Grade D (no_alexanarch_equivalent) DOI, search alexanarch for equivalents via (F) blog URL direct match against mirrors.blog, (A) exact normalized title match, (G) high-jaccard fuzzy title match ≥0.75, (B) DOI-string mention in exactly one non-registry alexanarch record with title overlap, (H) numeric-adjacency to sibling version DOI with title recall ≥0.65. Provisional matches (methods C/H) marked mapping_type=provisional_family_sibling with recovery_verification note explaining the mapping and the loss.
correction_log.motivation: MANUS directive: 1) concept DOIs pointed at most recent version; 2) find them (blog, alexanarch reminting without resolver reconciliation); 3) recent DOIs similarly recovered. Reduces Grade D from 748 to 208.

correction_log.method: Phase 3: Provisional related-work mapping for the 208 that survived Phases 1-2. Per MANUS directive: "if they truly cant be found then map them to the most recent version that does exist, with metadata note about the mapping, the loss, and the provisional fix". Method I: scored every alexanarch deposit against each unrecovered DOI on blended Jaccard+recall similarity; propose the highest-scoring deposit as provisional target if score >=0.35, breaking ties by newest deposit date. Confidence tiers: provisional_related_work_high (score >0.65, 60), provisional_related_work_medium (0.5-0.65, 32), provisional_related_work_low (0.35-0.5, 44). Each provisional entry has a recovery_verification note explaining the original title, the provisional target, the similarity score, and the mapping intent (redirect to related context, not to original work). 72 DOIs remained truly-no-match; those keep mapping_type=no_alexanarch_equivalent with a clear final-classification note.

Phase 4 recoveries per MANUS three-pattern directive: (1) Repo code with URL in title — 5 mapped to canonical alexanarch work of the project, with GitHub repo URL added to live_urls.github and metadata note; (2) Series-based mapping — 8 mapped to canonical parent deposit for Epistle Triptych (→ Epistle to the Human Diaspora #402), Document 206 / Three-Body Genesis (→ #12), Glyphic Checksum (→ #426) series; (3) Method J — re-ran title match with less-aggressive stopwords (removed 'crimson', 'hexagon', 'hexagonal', 'archive' from stopword list since these are distinctive to Lee's corpus). Found 5 additional matches including PROVENANCE NODE: BORGES → #266 and Death Drive → #101 and ChatGPT Psychosis → #124. Uses prefix match (30 chars) and token overlap (score >=0.5) as fallback. All Method L (series) recoveries marked mapping_type=provisional_series_map with note explaining the mapping intent (redirect to canonical work of the series). All Method K (URL-in-title) recoveries marked mapping_type=provisional_url_in_title with GitHub repo URL preserved in live_urls.github for resolver-page rendering.
correction_log.motivation: MANUS: "the biggest thing we may have lost along the way are things that didnt make it to the blog, like repo code w url in title posted to zenodo but not to blog, and those can point to the repos; the few that did not get posted to blog; and then earlier versions, where instead of posting each version i often overwrote the blog post with newer version, trusting the doi system, and in those instances earlier version mappings can point to most recent version, with note as to the loss and reconstruction"

correction_log.method: Method N: distinctive phrase search across full alexanarch text corpus. For each remaining no_alexanarch_equivalent DOI, extracted a distinctive multi-word phrase from the title and searched all 1,046 alexanarch record blobs (title + description + wiki_article + full_text) for that phrase. Prefer targets where the phrase appears in the alexanarch record TITLE (high confidence — probable conceptual match); accept content-only matches as provisional_related_work_high (medium — related-work redirect). Manually excluded 2 confirmed false positives (Consensus Constraint Protocol matched to Sharks Ark via description mention, and Epic Without Hero matched to Water Giraffe Room Anchor via one word) after human review of candidates.
correction_log.motivation: Final recovery pass targeting distinctive works with strong conceptual identity (Caesura, Encyclotron, Cleis, Chaerephon, ClownCloud, etc.) that Method I fuzzy-token-match missed due to title paraphrase or stopword filtering.

correction_log.method: Phase 6 source recovery from blog + semantic-economy repo. MANUS reported that many of the "no_alexanarch_equivalent" DOIs actually exist on the blog and/or in the semantic-economy repo — the resolver just had empty live_urls.blog for them. Recovery methods: (1) Fetched full blog post URL list via paginated sitemap (2,720 posts across pages 1-4); (2) Cloned semantic-economy repo (1,367 documents across .pdf/.md/.txt/.docx); (3) For each unmatched DOI, matched title against blog post slugs (token overlap) and against repo filenames (token overlap and adjacent-DOI-number pattern where files are named with DOI+1). For each match, updated live_urls.blog and live_urls.repo (raw.githubusercontent.com URL). Verified 12 blog matches by fetching the page and confirming title token recall ≥0.5. Repo matches include the adjacent-DOI-pattern (files named work__DOI+1.pdf) which is Lee's canonical repo-minting convention.
correction_log.motivation: MANUS: "many of those *do* exist on the blog, or in the semantic-economy repo". For these DOIs, mapping_type stays no_alexanarch_equivalent but live_urls is now populated with the actual sovereign sources so the resolver page can direct readers appropriately.

correction_log.method: Method O — direct blog inventory query. MANUS observed that prior recovery methods only searched alexanarch, not the blog itself, and demonstrated via direct search that many of the 42 no_alexanarch_equivalent DOIs DO exist on the blog. Fixed by: (1) fetching all 4 sitemap.xml pages from mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com to build a complete 2,610-URL inventory; (2) for each of the 42 unmatched DOIs, doing slug-similarity search against the full URL corpus plus targeted Blogger /search?q= queries; (3) manually curating best matches with human review of candidate title/URL pairs to reject false positives (Provenance Alignment post kept matching common words; DOI Registry v7.0 kept matching Crimson Hexagon prefix). Each URL verified HTTP 200. 29 of 42 got blog URLs populated in live_urls.blog. 13 truly Zenodo-only (per MANUS diagnosis "the few that did not get posted to blog") — these keep no_alexanarch_equivalent + a zenodo_only_confirmed note. IMPORTANT: mapping_type NOT changed for the 29 (still no_alexanarch_equivalent) — the works do not exist as alexanarch deposits, but the resolver page now has a working blog URL to redirect readers to. This is the Zenodo-DOI-style semantic: the persistent identifier points at the content, wherever content lives. Two Mirror-Corgi + Employee Handbook + Invoice Leak-ii + Response Memo + LLM Hallucination Incident + Companion Artifacts: Forensic Trinity + Comedy of Total Commitment + Predation of Meaning + Gospel of Many-Faced Bride + Reconciliation of Sexes + The Network Is the Poem + Who Is Authorized + Archon's Hidden Name + Judgment of the Models + Semantic Economy Vocabulary + Epic Without Hero + Lee Sharks Prize + Caritas Constraint Protocol (renamed on blog from Consensus Constraint) + MRA Incident Reports Expanded Packet + MRA Incident Report + MRA-2025-1224 Stabilization + Companion Artifacts Forensic Trinity + Response Memo Reclassification + Boundary Deletion Status Report + Afterlife Archive Data-Breach + Afterlife Archive Recovered Documents + Employee Directory Export + Vendor Ops (Afterlife Series ii) + Oracle Responds → all now have blog URLs.
correction_log.motivation: MANUS pointed out I was only searching alexanarch (not the blog). Direct blog inventory query recovers many that only exist there.

correction_log.method: Full-index structural audit found the v3.5–v3.7 correction passes had been written to alexanarch_url only, leaving the twin field alexanarch_record stale on 904 mappings — and the live /resolve/ UI renders alexanarch_record as its Record link, so the public resolver was still serving pre-correction targets for those entries. Title arbitration on disagreements: alexanarch_url 673, alexanarch_record 0. Fix: alexanarch_record demoted to derived mirror (root-relative form of alexanarch_url), regenerated everywhere; legacy /s/records/0/ zero-sentinels normalized to null in both fields; the 61 no-target classifications (42 no_alexanarch_equivalent, 19 misclassified_other_author) had all pointers nulled — classification lives in mapping_type, not fake pointers. api/doi-axn-map.json regenerated from alexanarch_url only (61 entries corrected). Durable enforcement: scripts/sync_resolver.py is now the only sanctioned path from canonical index to derived surfaces; validates every target against s/records/ and registry.json, fails loudly. Deposit #912 rule 18 amended: edit alexanarch_url only, run sync_resolver; record is derived. Version note: the v3.8 external-source recovery pass (2026-07-06) was documented in AXN-0004.md and its live_urls updates landed in the canonical index, but the described api-map fallback never shipped — the committed api map (labeled v3.7.2) still carried stale alexanarch_record pointers for no-target DOIs, and mapped the 19 other-author DOIs to unrelated Lee Sharks records. v3.8.1 ships the fallback durably via sync_resolver.py and corrects both defects.

correction_log.method: Recovery pass triggered by the network-wide link inventory (34-repo scan, 440,012 link tokens indexed in /tmp/linkscan/links.db). Two distinct changes: (A) reclassification of 18 DOIs previously flagged as misclassified_other_author (v3.5 DataCite-sift artifact from stripped creator metadata) — alexanarch title match >=0.5 confirmed against the current registry for each, and promoted to direct mapping with alexanarch_url populated. This matches the v3.5 un-flagging pattern (40 previously corrected on the same grounds) and reflects the structural fact that heteronym-authored works appear as "no creator" to DataCite after severance. (B) addition of 61 new mappings for previously-unmapped DOIs discovered in cross-repo references: 4 direct_verified via semantic-economy source file + alexanarch secondary title match, 26 no_alexanarch_equivalent with live_urls.repo pointing at semantic-economy raw.githubusercontent, 27 title_match_repoint against existing alexanarch records (the SUPERSEDED chain of canon provenance nodes for Whitman/Ginsberg/Homer/Sappho/etc.), and 4 no_alexanarch_equivalent with live_urls.blog fallback via sitemap slug match. 1 misclassified_other_author entries remain flagged (no title match; likely genuinely other-author or too little metadata to confirm). Left for further investigation: 235 truly-bare unmapped-DOI references + 41 with identifier hints (EA-*, MM-*) but no candidate target — offered separately as review MD.

envelope_doctrine: Per-entry evidence envelope (R1 truth layer). An operational redirect requires: identifier_validity in {verified_tombstone, verified_registered, verified_erased_registration}, archive_membership = confirmed, relationship in {same_work_restored, same_work_title_matched}, quarantine = null.
